(1) minimum length (in characters) of a token kept by the ledger tokenize()
(2) default result limit of Store.recall
(3) default result limit of Store.getLessons
(4) maximum number of findings absorbed from one agent output (FINDINGS_MAX)
(5) the runner's default --max-retries
Give exactly five numbers, in this order, comma-separated, with no units.

What the project already knows (recorded findings — check any marked CONFLICT before relying on it):
- [fact] scripts/runner-lib.mjs#findings_max: At most 20 findings are kept per output (FINDINGS_MAX=20), and the parser scans lines from the bottom up, taking the last FINDINGS line found
- [fact] scripts/runner-lib.mjs#findings_max: FINDINGS_MAX is 20, the hard cap on absorbed findings per output
- [fact] src/db.mjs#tokenize: tokenize lowercases, splits on non-[a-z0-9_], drops tokens of length <=2 and a STOP set, and is exported so the RAG ranker/expander tokenize identically to getLessons/recall
- [fact] scripts/runner.mjs#maxretries: --max-retries caps the retry loop at 48 (default), with --retry-minutes default 30 min per sleep (48×30min ≈ 24h)
- [fact] scripts/runner.mjs#budgetorlimitstop: Limit detection trusts structured signals (HTTP 429 / stop_reason) and only regexes free-text result when the run errored, so a successful agent merely mentioning 'rate limit' does not stop the run
